source.title: Best Fantasy Football Draft Values in Every Round (2026)
source.author: FantasyPros Staff
source.summary: Selects the best value in each round of a 12-team, one-quarterback PPR draft.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Cook's three-year rushing growth and consecutive 16-point PPR seasons make him a strong late-first value.
takeaways.rationale: Cook's three-year rushing growth and consecutive 16-point PPR seasons make him a strong late-first value.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Brown has consecutive top-10-caliber seasons, stable featured usage, and a high-scoring offense.
takeaways.rationale: Brown has consecutive top-10-caliber seasons, stable featured usage, and a high-scoring offense.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Rice's on-field production supports a third-round value if legal, suspension, and knee issues clear.
takeaways.rationale: Rice's on-field production supports a third-round value if legal, suspension, and knee issues clear.
risks: Possible suspension, knee recovery, and off-field risk.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Skattebo's healthy 2025 stretch showed RB1 production at a fourth-round price.
takeaways.rationale: Skattebo's healthy 2025 stretch showed RB1 production at a fourth-round price.
risks: Recovery from a major ankle injury.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Moore gains Josh Allen and a path to become Buffalo's first true go-to receiver since Stefon Diggs.
takeaways.rationale: Moore gains Josh Allen and a path to become Buffalo's first true go-to receiver since Stefon Diggs.
risks: Role projection in a new offense.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Odunze's hot 2025 start and DJ Moore's departure create a path to top-12 production.
takeaways.rationale: Odunze's hot 2025 start and DJ Moore's departure create a path to top-12 production.
risks: Luther Burden and Colston Loveland still compete for targets.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Kraft's pre-injury TE1 scoring rate and Green Bay's vacated targets support an elite ceiling.
takeaways.rationale: Kraft's pre-injury TE1 scoring rate and Green Bay's vacated targets support an elite ceiling.
